'''Roden Venthrall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Venthrall had been a student of the master assassin [[Dolac Legasi]]. However, by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Legasi had been imprisoned in an [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial prison]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and Venthrall worked on his own.<ref name="SWG:I" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Roden Venthrall was hired to assassinate [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian criminal syndicate]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Lady Valarian's lieutenant [[Ind]] later discovered the situation and tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Venthrall before. The spacer eventually found the assassin near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and attacked him. Roden Venthrall was killed during the ensuring firefight.<ref name="SWG:I" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Roden Venthrall]]
Roden Venthrall was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:I" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Roden Venthrall was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:I" />

Because Roden Venthrall spawned under the generic "assassin" template, his appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Venthrall could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] under either gender. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Venthrall as male, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="SWG:I" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Roden Venthrall was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
